name: vault-browse-resolve
comment: Vault Browse face execution plan, Slice 6 (living tile states) — resolve-in-place: a fixture comic folder with a title that has exactly ONE exact match in the production offline comics catalogue (data/comics_catalog.db, gcd_id 3636, verified by direct query 2026-08-13) so the boot-time progressive auto-identify pass (VaultLibrary::runAutoIdentifySlice, already scheduled on every index change) adopts it with no user action. Run with --seed tests/fixtures/vault/browse-states-smoke-seed (an absolute path; its vault/config.json points a confirmed root at tests/fixtures/vault/browse-states-smoke, which holds two sibling comic folders — Akira/ for this scenario, Masterpiece/ for vault_browse_uncertain.json). The fixture .cbz is a copy of the existing tests/fixtures/tankoban/tiny-volume.cbz (a REAL small valid archive) — a 1-byte stub .cbz was tried first and found to trip VaultEnricher's corrupt-archive detection, which sets errorState and makes the group INELIGIBLE for auto-identify (matchGroup/autoIdentifyExisting both skip rows with a non-empty errorState) — recorded here so the next author does not repeat the same dead end.
